```
['convert an OBJ mesh file to binary MuJoCo MSH format by parsing and relabeling vertices', 'parse an OBJ file from a path into a list of meshes with vertices, faces, texcoords, and normals', 'convert mesh vertex, face, texcoord, and normal lists into a binary MSH format string', 'relabel OBJ mesh vertices, texcoords, and normals to a MuJoCo compatible flat format', 'flatten a sequence of sequences into a single flat list using itertools']

```
